text: Hey there! How has your week been going so far?
It’s been pretty busy, to be honest, but really productive. What about yours?
Same here! I had back-to-back team meetings all morning, but we finally finalized the new project roadmap.
That’s awesome! It must feel like a huge relief to have that off your plate.
It definitely does. Are you doing anything special this coming weekend?
I’m thinking of taking a quick road trip to the coast if the weather holds up. How about you?
Sounds wonderful! I’ll probably just catch up on some reading and have coffee with a close friend.
